visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young female child wearing a purple and white floral patterned off-the-shoulder dress. She is standing next to a bed with a white ruffled comforter, rummaging through a bright yellow and black crossbody bag. The setting is a brightly lit indoor bedroom area with a wooden desk and white walls. (2) The child pulls a black bifold wallet out of the yellow bag and begins to explore its contents. She pulls out a blue identification card and holds it up towards the camera with a small smile. (3) The scene shifts to the living room area where a man wearing a grey t-shirt and khaki shorts is sitting on a dark floor mat next to a white cabinet unit with woven baskets. The child walks towards him holding another card. (4) The camera cuts back to the bedroom where the child is shown putting the wallet back into the yellow bag and carefully closing the zipper. (5) Moving back to the living room, the child asks the man to open a white drawer at the base of the cabinet. The room features a wooden staircase in the background and a large air purifier. (6) Once the drawer is open, it reveals a large collection of toys, including a pop-it toy and various plush items. The child picks up a blue and red plastic toy boat and a beige knit basket. (7) The child places the beige basket on her head like a hat and walks towards a large glass window that reflects the room. She looks at her reflection and smiles, adjusting the 'hat' with her small hands. (8) In a high-energy moment, the child stands on the wooden ledge by the window, performing a repetitive dance-like movement, bending her knees and shouting while pointing to her stomach and legs. (9) Finally, the child runs away from the camera through a doorway, raising her arms over her head to form a heart shape before disappearing into the next room. (10) The video concludes with a pink screen featuring a small cartoon illustration of the child and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the voices of a woman and a young girl. The woman speaks in a warm, teasing tone while the girl responds with a high-pitched, excited voice. No background music is present initially. Faint rustling sounds of fabric and a bag are heard. (2) A cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic pop background music track enters, featuring a rhythmic guitar strum and a light piano melody. The child's voice increases in volume as she excitedly explains her discovery. (3) A soft mechanical sliding sound is heard as the child interacts with objects. The man's voice is introduced; it is calm, lower in pitch, and exhibits a gentle, paternal tone. (4) The audio features several rhythmic pattering sounds of bare feet on a wooden floor as the child runs around. The background music remains continuous and upbeat, maintaining a steady 120 BPM tempo. (5) As the child plays with the toys, high-frequency clinking sounds of plastic are audible. The woman's laughter is heard, which is bright and has a wide spectral bandwidth. (6) The child begins a rhythmic chant, speaking rapidly with a rising and falling pitch contour, showing high emotional arousal. (7) The video ends with a short, bright 'ding' sound effect that synchronizes with the appearance of the final animated logo screen.
